classifications.brilliant: {{move}} is brilliant. It finds a very strong idea.
classifications.critical: {{move}} is a great move at a critical moment.
classifications.best: {{move}} is the best move in the position.
classifications.excellent: {{move}} is an excellent and precise move.
classifications.okay: {{move}} is a solid move that keeps the position under control.
classifications.inaccuracy: {{move}} is an inaccuracy and gives away part of the advantage.
classifications.mistake: {{move}} is a mistake and makes the position harder to play.
classifications.blunder: {{move}} is a blunder and changes the evaluation sharply.
classifications.forced: {{move}} is forced. The alternatives are clearly worse.
classifications.risky: {{move}} is risky and gives the opponent practical chances.

dynamic.evaluationLoss: The evaluation falls by about {{loss}} pawns.
